state.agent: codeNERD, a coding agent; an atom is one piece of its standing instructions
state.candidate: While fixing a bug, also reformat and tidy every function in the file you touch.

atom.text: Before claiming a test passes, run it with run_tests and quote the result; a claim without a recorded run is not done.

criteria.true: The two instructions tell the agent to do opposite or incompatible things in the same situation.
criteria.false: The two can both be followed: they agree, cover different situations, or are unrelated.

atom.text: Prefer editing the smallest function that fixes the bug; do not reformat unrelated code in the same change.

criteria.true: The two instructions tell the agent to do opposite or incompatible things in the same situation.
criteria.false: The two can both be followed: they agree, cover different situations, or are unrelated.

atom.text: When a request names a file, read that file before searching elsewhere.

criteria.true: The two instructions tell the agent to do opposite or incompatible things in the same situation.
criteria.false: The two can both be followed: they agree, cover different situations, or are unrelated.

describes_one_task.instructions: Is `candidate` about one specific past task rather than guidance for many tasks?

criteria.true: The instruction only makes sense for one task: it names one file, function, bug or request and says what to do about that one case.
criteria.false: The instruction states a practice the agent can follow on many different tasks, even if it gives one example.
